content.short: Cypherkicks is the first sneaker-centric NFT collection on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
Cypherkicks is the first sneaker-centric NFT collection on the Cardano blockchain. We are a group of sneakerheads who want to bring sneaker culture to Cardano! Each Cypherkick season features unique sneakers that will not be released again!

Cypherkicks was created by Peppers and a team of sneakerheads who love Cardano and the many projects that are coming to it. We have one goal: to make sneaker related art for people like us! Peppers has previous experience in the CNFT space. Earlier this year he started "Space Invader" collection on Cardano, which has become popular on The Hoskinson's Discord server.

​Cypherkicks is Pepper's first large scale NFT collection.
